title: MallWorld with mansion attached
content: Hi everyone, I've been visiting MallWorld for as long as I can remember. Every time I dream, I go there. My MallWorld has a beach in the back with a waterpark. The mall is circular and has a lot of random stores. It's also near a school that looks very old and wooden. Now, however, there seems to be a new attachment of a huge mansion. Everything is white inside the mansion and it has a huge basement with tons of furniture. Anyone visit these places?
